release_notes: Specs per the official QuarkView product page (Shenzhen Kuake Trading Co., Ltd.); the page states 5MP, PoE, IP66 metal housing, two-way audio, human detection, 2 IR + 2 white LEDs, H.265 and ONVIF, and describes it as a bullet camera. The page names no app and links no manual, so cloud_dependency is omitted and only an ONVIF config is given (no RTSP path is published for this model). Lens, field of view, frame rate, IR range, sensor and dimensions are not published.

frigate.notes: No RTSP path published; discover via ONVIF.

home_assistant.notes: The product page lists ONVIF support; the ONVIF port is not published.
